chunks.text: NET-7310 means the egress queue is full. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7310, drain the egress queue and raise its capacity. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-73100 means a peer rejected the mutual TLS handshake. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-73100, reissue the peer certificate and retry the handshake. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7301 means the shard map is older than the router state. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7301, refresh the shard map from the control plane. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7130 means the circuit breaker opened for a backend group. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7130, reset the breaker after the backend group is healthy. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7311 means two listeners requested the same bind address. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7311, assign a distinct bind address to each listener. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7312 means the signing key rotation did not finish. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7312, rerun the key rotation job to completion. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-73101 means the buffer pool was fragmented beyond its limit. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-73101, restart the worker to rebuild the buffer pool. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7031 means a traffic mirror target stopped responding. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7031, point the mirror at a reachable target. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7320 means the policy bundle failed its checksum. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7320, download the policy bundle again. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7131 means the load balancer saw an unknown zone label. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7131, add the zone label to the balancer inventory. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7302 means the idle reaper closed an active stream. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7302, extend the idle timeout for streaming routes. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7313 means the cluster clock drifted past the allowed skew. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7313, resync the cluster clocks with NTP. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-73110 means a webhook receiver returned too many errors. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-73110, disable the webhook until the receiver recovers. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7321 means the session cache was evicted during a rollout. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7321, warm the session cache before the next rollout. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7132 means the gRPC deadline was shorter than the backend timeout. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7132, lengthen the gRPC deadline. Confirm the result in the status page.
NET-7303 means the license file expired. It is reported by the data plane at error level.
To recover from NET-7303, install a renewed license file. Confirm the result in the status page.

Ticket TCK-4101 reported stalled batch jobs in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4101 was a worker pool with zero threads. Support resolved it to restore the worker thread count.
Ticket TCK-4104 reported garbled email subjects in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4104 was a charset mismatch in the mail library. Support resolved it to set the mail charset to UTF-8.
Ticket TCK-4107 reported duplicate invoices in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4107 was a retried payment callback. Support resolved it to deduplicate the payment callback.
Ticket TCK-4110 reported slow dashboard tiles in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4110 was an unindexed dashboard query. Support resolved it to add the missing index.
Ticket TCK-4113 reported missing shipping labels in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4113 was a printer service outage. Support resolved it to restart the printer service.
Ticket TCK-4116 reported failed webhook retries in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4116 was a webhook secret that changed. Support resolved it to update the webhook secret.
Ticket TCK-4119 reported expired tokens in the portal in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4119 was a token signer using the wrong clock. Support resolved it to sync the signer clock.
Ticket TCK-4122 reported stuck upload progress bars in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4122 was a proxy that buffered request bodies. Support resolved it to disable proxy buffering.
Ticket TCK-4125 reported truncated exports in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4125 was a row limit left at its default. Support resolved it to raise the row limit.
Ticket TCK-4128 reported wrong time zones in reports in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4128 was a locale file that failed to load. Support resolved it to reload the locale files.
Ticket TCK-4131 reported blank audit pages in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4131 was a template cache that never refreshed. Support resolved it to clear the template cache.
Ticket TCK-4134 reported repeated login prompts in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4134 was a cookie scoped to the wrong domain. Support resolved it to scope the cookie to the root domain.
Ticket TCK-4137 reported lost mobile sessions in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4137 was a push gateway certificate that expired. Support resolved it to renew the push certificate.
Ticket TCK-4140 reported delayed push messages in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4140 was a queue consumer that crashed silently. Support resolved it to restart the queue consumer.
Ticket TCK-4143 reported unreadable attachments in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4143 was a virus scanner that held files. Support resolved it to whitelist the attachment type.
Ticket TCK-4146 reported frozen search suggestions in the support portal.
The cause of TCK-4146 was a suggestion index that was not rebuilt. Support resolved it to rebuild the suggestion index.
